scope: KooshaPari/Dino-fork versus KooshaPari/Dino ancestry and boundary

local.interpretation: AgilePlus/Dino is not a Dino-fork checkout and must not be treated as local preservation evidence for Dino-fork.

decision.reason: The repositories share a product family but are independent GitHub repositories with divergent histories. Redirecting Dino-fork to Dino or phenotype-apps without a sponsor-approved ancestry/reconciliation plan would lose provenance and obscure the AgilePlus DAG branch.
decision.next_gate: Sponsor chooses archive-only lineage versus a reviewed, commit-level reconciliation into Dino; no deletion, force-push, or absorption is authorized by this audit.

source: GitHub REST repository metadata and compare API, plus read-only local checkout inspection
